name: mingo-ai
description: Mingo AI — an AI-powered software engineering platform. Phase 2: AI chat & project conversations.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.build:client: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
